name: Node Network Signal Travel & Target Pulse
visual_intent: Shows communication packet or gradient signal propagating between two nodes on an architecture graph with arrival deformation.

parameters.name: packetSelector
parameters.description: Selector for traveling SVG circle element.

parameters.name: targetSelector
parameters.description: Selector for destination node element to pulse upon arrival.

parameters.name: fromCoords
parameters.description: Origin coordinates { x: number, y: number }.

parameters.name: toCoords
parameters.description: Destination coordinates { x: number, y: number }.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Timestamp in seconds to begin transmission.

timeline_requirements.timing_anchors: Anchored to voice narration describing packet transfer or dispatch.
timeline_requirements.easing_standard: power1.inOut for travel, power2.out for arrival pulse.

code_snippet.html:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1280 720">
  <circle id="signal-dot" cx="0" cy="0" r="5" fill="#58a6ff" opacity="0"/>
  <g id="target-node">
    <rect x="800" y="320" width="120" height="80" rx="8" fill="#161b22" stroke="#30363d"/>
  </g>
</svg>

fallbacks: Instant line highlight (stroke-color pulse) if dot tween is not desired.
validation_steps: Snapshot at startTime + 0.15 + (travelDuration / 2) to confirm dot midway between coordinates.
Snapshot at startTime + 0.15 + travelDuration + 0.1 to confirm target node scale deformation.
